legend: Christina has a rooted tree with n$$$n$$$ vertices. Initially, all vertices are colored green, except for the root, which is colored red. Christina thinks that the tree is beautiful if two rules are satisfied:
If the vertex is colored red, all vertices on the shortest path between it and the root are also red.

Christina repeatedly performs the following operation on the tree — chooses a vertex and changes its color (if it was red, colors it green; if it was green, colors it red). The following rules must be satisfied while performing the operations:
The coloring of vertices should be unique. That means there is no moment in the past when each vertex had the same color as it has right now.
Your task is to help Christina build the longest possible sequence of operations following the rules.
input: The first line contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤20$$$1 \le n \le 20$$$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

The second line contains n−1$$$n - 1$$$ integers pi$$$p_i$$$ (1≤pi≤i$$$1 \le p_i \le i$$$ for 1≤i≤n−1$$$1 \le i \le n - 1$$$), denoting parent vertices in the tree. The vertices in the tree are numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, the root has number 1$$$1$$$, the i$$$i$$$-th vertex has parent pi−1$$$p_{i-1}$$$ for 2≤i≤n$$$2 \le i \le n$$$.
output: On the first line output an integer m$$$m$$$ — the maximum number of operations.
On the second line output m$$$m$$$ integers oi$$$o_i$$$ (2≤oi≤n)$$$2 \le o_i \le n)$$$. oi$$$o_i$$$ is the number of the vertex that changes color during the corresponding operation.
If there are several possible longest sequences, output any one of them.

legend.ai: Christina 有一棵包含 n$$$n$$$ 个顶点的有根树。初始时，除根节点被染成红色外，所有顶点都被染成绿色。Christina 认为，当满足以下两条规则时，这棵树是美丽的：
如果某个顶点被染成红色，那么它与根之间最短路径上的所有顶点也都被染成红色。
Christina 反复在树上执行以下操作——选择一个顶点并改变其颜色（如果它是红色，就将其染成绿色；如果它是绿色，就将其染成红色）。在执行这些操作的过程中，必须满足以下规则：
这棵树应始终保持美丽。
顶点的染色方案应当是唯一的。这意味着在过去不存在某个时刻，使得每个顶点的颜色都与此刻相同。
你的任务是帮助 Christina 在遵循这些规则的前提下，构造尽可能长的操作序列。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤20$$$1 \le n \le 20$$$)——树中顶点的数量。

第二行包含 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 个整数 pi$$$p_i$$$(对于 1≤i≤n−1$$$1 \le p_i \le i$$$，有 1≤pi≤i$$$1 \le i \le n - 1$$$)，表示树中的父顶点。树中顶点编号为 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$，根节点编号为 1$$$1$$$，第 i$$$i$$$ 个顶点的父节点为 pi−1$$$p_{i-1}$$$，其中 2≤i≤n$$$2 \le i \le n$$$。

output.ai: 在第一行输出一个整数 m$$$m$$$——操作的最大数量。
在第二行输出 m$$$m$$$ 个整数 oi$$$o_i$$$(2≤oi≤n$$$2 \le o_i \le n)$$$)。oi$$$o_i$$$ 是相应操作中改变颜色的顶点的编号。
如果存在多个可能的最长序列，输出其中任意一个。
